<script>
export default {
  props: ['chatMode', 'openChat', 'kanban'],
  data() {
    return {
      showFile: null,
      addFile: null,
      showChatsTree: false,
      editName: false,
      showSettings: false,
      addNewFile: null,
      showHidden: false,
      confirmDelete: false,
      newTag: null,
      toggleChatOptions: false
    }
  },
  mounted () {
    this.toggleChatOptions = !this.$ui.isMobile
  },
  computed: {
    chatModes () {
      return this.$projects.chatModes
    },
    subProjects () {
      return [
          this.$project,
          ...this.$projects.childProjects || [],
          ...this.$projects.projectDependencies || []
      ]
    },
    hiddenCount() {
      return this.chat.messages?.filter(m => m.hide).length
    },
    messages() {
      return this.chat.messages.filter(m => !m.hide || this.showHidden)
    },
    chatUpdatedDate() {
      const updatedAt = this.chat.updated_at
      return moment(updatedAt).isAfter(moment().subtract(7, 'days'))
        ? moment(updatedAt).fromNow()
        : moment(updatedAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD')
    },
    chats() {
      return this.$projects.allChats
    },
    chat() {
      return this.$projects.chats[this.openChat?.id || this.$projects.activeChat.id]
    },
    parentChat() {
      const parentId = this.chat.parent_id
      return parentId ? this.chats.find(c => c.id && c.id === parentId) : null
    },
    childrenChats() {
      return this.$storex.projects.allChats.filter(c => c.parent_id === this.chat.id)
        .sort((a, b) => (a.updated_at || a.created_at) > (b.updated_at || b.created_at) ? -1 : 1)
    },
    chatProject() {
      return this.$projects.allProjects.find(p => p.project_id === this.chat.project_id) ||
              this.$project
    },
    parentChat () {
      return this.$projects.allChats.find(c => c.id === this.chat.parent_id)
    },
    chatFiles() {
      return [...this.chat.file_list||[], ...this.parentChat?.file_list||[]]
    }
  },
  methods: {
    async saveChat() {
      this.editName = false
      await this.$projects.saveChat(this.chat)
    },
    async confirmDeleteChat() {
      this.confirmDelete = false
      const parent_id = this.chat.parent_id
      await this.$projects.deleteChat(this.chat)
      const parentChat = this.parentChat
      if (parentChat) {
        this.$projects.setActiveChat(parentChat)
      } else {
        this.navigateToChats()
      }
    },
    resetConfirmDelete() {
      this.confirmDelete = false
    },
    async loadChat(chat) {
      await this.$projects.setActiveChat(chat)
      this.showChatsTree = false
    },
    async removeFileFromContext() {
      this.chat.profiles = this.chat.profiles?.filter(f => f !== this.showFile)
      this.onRemoveFile(this.showFile)
      await this.loadChat(this.chat)
      this.showFile = null
    },
    async addFileToContext() {
      this.onAddFile(this.addFile)
      await this.saveChat()
      await this.loadChat(this.chat)
      this.showFile = null
      this.addFile = null
    },
    async onAddFile(file) {
      if (this.chat.file_list?.includes(file)) {
        return
      }
      this.chat.file_list = [...(this.chat.file_list || []), file]
      this.addNewFile = null
      await this.saveChat()
    },
    async onRemoveFile(file) {
      this.chat.file_list = (this.chat.file_list || []).filter(f => f !== file)
      this.addNewFile = null
      await this.saveChat()
    },
    async addProfile(profile) {
      if (this.chat.profiles?.includes(profile)) {
        return
      }
      this.chat.profiles = [...this.chat.profiles || [], profile]
      await this.saveChat()
    },
    removeProfile(profile) {
      if (this.chat.profiles?.includes(profile)) {
        this.chat.profiles = this.chat.profiles.filter(p => p !== profile)
        this.saveChat()
      }
    },
    onRemoveMessage(message) {
      const ix = this.chat.messages.findIndex(m => m.doc_id === message.doc_id)
      if (this.chat.mode == 'task' && message.role === "assistant" && ix > 1) {
        this.chat.messages[ix - 1].hide = false
      }
      this.chat.messages = this.chat.messages.filter((_, i) => i !== ix)
      this.saveChat()
    },
    navigateToChats() {
      this.$emit('chats')
    },
    async newSubChat() {
      @codx-ok, please-wait...: Create a new subtask modal asking for the subtask name and a opional short description, call emit when user press "create" or close modal with "cancel"
      this.$emit('sub-task', this.chat)
    },
    addNewTag() {
      this.chat.tags = [...new Set([...this.chat.tags || [], this.newTag])]
      this.newTag = null
      this.saveChat()
    },
    removeTag(tag) {
      this.chat.tags = this.chat.tags.filter(t => t !== tag)
      this.saveChat()
    },
    setChatMode(mode, profile) {
      this.chat.mode = mode
      this.chat.profiles = [profile]
      this.saveChat()
    },
    async createSubTasks() {
      await this.$storex.projects.createSubTasks(this.chat)
    },
    naviageToParent() {
      if (this.parentChat) {
        this.$emit('chat', this.parentChat)
      } else {
        this.navigateToChats()
      }
    }
  }
}
</script>

<script>
export default {
  props: ['chatMode', 'openChat', 'kanban'],
  data() {
    return {
      showFile: null,
      addFile: null,
      showChatsTree: false,
      editName: false,
      showSettings: false,
      addNewFile: null,
      showHidden: false,
      confirmDelete: false,
      newTag: null,
      toggleChatOptions: false,
      showSubtaskModal: false,
      subtaskName: '',
      subtaskDescription: ''
    }
  },
  mounted () {
    this.toggleChatOptions = !this.$ui.isMobile
  },
  computed: {
    chatModes () {
      return this.$projects.chatModes
    },
    subProjects () {
      return [
          this.$project,
          ...this.$projects.childProjects || [],
          ...this.$projects.projectDependencies || []
      ]
    },
    hiddenCount() {
      return this.chat.messages?.filter(m => m.hide).length
    },
    messages() {
      return this.chat.messages.filter(m => !m.hide || this.showHidden)
    },
    chatUpdatedDate() {
      const updatedAt = this.chat.updated_at
      return moment(updatedAt).isAfter(moment().subtract(7, 'days'))
        ? moment(updatedAt).fromNow()
        : moment(updatedAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD')
    },
    chats() {
      return this.$projects.allChats
    },
    chat() {
      return this.$projects.chats[this.openChat?.id || this.$projects.activeChat.id]
    },
    parentChat() {
      const parentId = this.chat.parent_id
      return parentId ? this.chats.find(c => c.id && c.id === parentId) : null
    },
    childrenChats() {
      return this.$storex.projects.allChats.filter(c => c.parent_id === this.chat.id)
        .sort((a, b) => (a.updated_at || a.created_at) > (b.updated_at || b.created_at) ? -1 : 1)
    },
    chatProject() {
      return this.$projects.allProjects.find(p => p.project_id === this.chat.project_id) ||
              this.$project
    },
    parentChat () {
      return this.$projects.allChats.find(c => c.id === this.chat.parent_id)
    },
    chatFiles() {
      return [...this.chat.file_list||[], ...this.parentChat?.file_list||[]]
    }
  },
  methods: {
    async saveChat() {
      this.editName = false
      await this.$projects.saveChat(this.chat)
    },
    async confirmDeleteChat() {
      this.confirmDelete = false
      const parent_id = this.chat.parent_id
      await this.$projects.deleteChat(this.chat)
      const parentChat = this.parentChat
      if (parentChat) {
        this.$projects.setActiveChat(parentChat)
      } else {
        this.navigateToChats()
      }
    },
    resetConfirmDelete() {
      this.confirmDelete = false
    },
    async loadChat(chat) {
      await this.$projects.setActiveChat(chat)
      this.showChatsTree = false
    },
    async removeFileFromContext() {
      this.chat.profiles = this.chat.profiles?.filter(f => f !== this.showFile)
      this.onRemoveFile(this.showFile)
      await this.loadChat(this.chat)
      this.showFile = null
    },
    async addFileToContext() {
      this.onAddFile(this.addFile)
      await this.saveChat()
      await this.loadChat(this.chat)
      this.showFile = null
      this.addFile = null
    },
    async onAddFile(file) {
      if (this.chat.file_list?.includes(file)) {
        return
      }
      this.chat.file_list = [...(this.chat.file_list || []), file]
      this.addNewFile = null
      await this.saveChat()
    },
    async onRemoveFile(file) {
      this.chat.file_list = (this.chat.file_list || []).filter(f => f !== file)
      this.addNewFile = null
      await this.saveChat()
    },
    async addProfile(profile) {
      if (this.chat.profiles?.includes(profile)) {
        return
      }
      this.chat.profiles = [...this.chat.profiles || [], profile]
      await this.saveChat()
    },
    removeProfile(profile) {
      if (this.chat.profiles?.includes(profile)) {
        this.chat.profiles = this.chat.profiles.filter(p => p !== profile)
        this.saveChat()
      }
    },
    onRemoveMessage(message) {
      const ix = this.chat.messages.findIndex(m => m.doc_id === message.doc_id)
      if (this.chat.mode == 'task' && message.role === "assistant" && ix > 1) {
        this.chat.messages[ix - 1].hide = false
      }
      this.chat.messages = this.chat.messages.filter((_, i) => i !== ix)
      this.saveChat()
    },
    navigateToChats() {
      this.$emit('chats')
    },
    async newSubChat() {
      this.showSubtaskModal = true
    },
    createSubtask() {
      if (this.subtaskName.trim()) {
        this.$emit('sub-task', {
          name: this.subtaskName,
          description: this.subtaskDescription
        })
        this.resetSubtaskModal()
      }
    },
    cancelSubtask() {
      this.resetSubtaskModal()
    },
    resetSubtaskModal() {
      this.showSubtaskModal = false
      this.subtaskName = ''
      this.subtaskDescription = ''
    },
    addNewTag() {
      this.chat.tags = [...new Set([...this.chat.tags || [], this.newTag])]
      this.newTag = null
      this.saveChat()
    },
    removeTag(tag) {
      this.chat.tags = this.chat.tags.filter(t => t !== tag)
      this.saveChat()
    },
    setChatMode(mode, profile) {
      this.chat.mode = mode
      this.chat.profiles = [profile]
      this.saveChat()
    },
    async createSubTasks() {
      await this.$storex.projects.createSubTasks(this.chat)
    },
    naviageToParent() {
      if (this.parentChat) {
        this.$emit('chat', this.parentChat)
      } else {
        this.navigateToChats()
      }
    }
  }
}
</script>

            <select v-model="chat.project_id" class="select select-bordered select-xs w-full max-w-xs"
              @change="saveChat"
            >
              <option v-for="project in subProjects" :key="project.project_id"
                :value="project.project_id"
                :selected="project.project_id === chatProject.project_id"
              >
              {{ project.project_name }} <span>({{ $projects.aiModel }})</span>
              </option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="w-full overflow-auto" v-if="chatFiles.length">
          <div class="my-2 text-xs">
            <span>
              <i class="fa-solid fa-paperclip"></i>
            </span>
            <a v-for="file in chatFiles" :key="file" :data-tip="file" class="group text-nowrap ml-2 hover:underline hover:bg-base-300 click text-accent" @click="$ui.openFile(file)">
              <span>{{ file.split('/').reverse()[0] }}</span>
              <span class="ml-2 click" @click.stop="onRemoveFile(file)">
                <i class="fa-regular fa-circle-xmark"></i>
              </span>
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Chat :chatId="chat.id"
          :showHidden="showHidden"
          :childrenChats="childrenChats"
          @refresh-chat="loadChat(chat)"
          @add-file="onAddFile"
          @remove-file="onRemoveFile" 
          @delete-message="onRemoveMessage"
          @delete="confirmDelete = true"
          @save="saveChat" 
          v-if="chat"/>
        <modal v-if="confirmDelete">
          <div class="">
            <h3 class="font-bold text-lg">Confirm Delete</h3>
            <p class="text-error font-bold">Are you sure you want to delete this chat?</p>
            <div class="text-xl p-1">{{ chat.name }}</div>
            <div class="modal-action">
              <button class="btn btn-error" @click="confirmDeleteChat">Delete</button>
              <button class="btn" @click="resetConfirmDelete">Cancel</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </modal>
        <modal class="modal modal-open" role="dialog" v-if="showFile || addFile !== null">
          <div class="modal-box flex flex-col gap-4 p-4">
            <h3 class="font-bold text-lg" v-if="showFile">
              This file belongs to the task context:
              <div class="font-thin">{{ showFile }}</div>
            </h3>
            <div v-else>
              <input type="text" class="input input-bordered w-full" v-model="addFile" placeholder="Add file to context, full path" />
            </div>
            <div class="flex gap-2 justify-center">
              <button class="btn btn-error" @click="removeFileFromContext" v-if="showFile">
                Remove
              </button>
              <button class="btn btn-primary" @click="addFileToContext" v-else>
                Add
              </button>
              <button class="btn" @click="addFile = showFile = null">
                Close
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </modal>
        <modal v-if="newTag !== null">
          <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <div class="text-xl">New tag</div>
            <select class="select select-sm select-bordered" @change="newTag = $event.target.value">
              <option value="" selected>New</option>
              <option v-for="t in $projects.allTags" :key="t" :value="t">{{t}}</option>
            </select>
            <input type="text" class="input input-sm input-bordered" v-model="newTag" />
            <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
              <button class="btn btn-error" @click="newTag = null">
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button class="btn" @click="addNewTag" :disabled="newTag.length === 0">
                Add
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </modal>
        <modal v-if="showSubtaskModal">
          <div class="flex flex-col gap-4 p-4">
            <h3 class="font-bold text-lg">Create New Subtask</h3>
            <input v-model="subtaskName" type="text" class="input input-bordered" placeholder="Subtask Name" />
            <textarea v-model="subtaskDescription" class="textarea textarea-bordered" placeholder="Short Description (optional)" rows="3"></textarea>
            <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
              <button class="btn btn-error" @click="cancelSubtask">Cancel</button>
              <button class="btn btn-primary" @click="createSubtask">Create</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </modal>
      </div>
      <add-file-dialog v-if="addNewFile" @open="onAddFile" @close="addNewFile = false" />
    </div>
  </div>

<script>
export default {
  props: ['chatMode', 'openChat', 'kanban'],
  data() {
    return {
      showFile: null,
      addFile: null,
      showChatsTree: false,
      editName: false,
      showSettings: false,
      addNewFile: null,
      showHidden: false,
      confirmDelete: false,
      newTag: null,
      toggleChatOptions: false,
      showSubtaskModal: false,
      subtaskName: '',
      subtaskDescription: ''
    }
  },
  mounted () {
    this.toggleChatOptions = !this.$ui.isMobile
  },
  computed: {
    chatModes () {
      return this.$projects.chatModes
    },
    subProjects () {
      return [
          this.$project,
          ...this.$projects.childProjects || [],
          ...this.$projects.projectDependencies || []
      ]
    },
    hiddenCount() {
      return this.chat.messages?.filter(m => m.hide).length
    },
    messages() {
      return this.chat.messages.filter(m => !m.hide || this.showHidden)
    },
    chatUpdatedDate() {
      const updatedAt = this.chat.updated_at
      return moment(updatedAt).isAfter(moment().subtract(7, 'days'))
        ? moment(updatedAt).fromNow()
        : moment(updatedAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD')
    },
    chats() {
      return this.$projects.allChats
    },
    chat() {
      return this.$projects.chats[this.openChat?.id || this.$projects.activeChat.id]
    },
    parentChat() {
      const parentId = this.chat.parent_id
      return parentId ? this.chats.find(c => c.id && c.id === parentId) : null
    },
    childrenChats() {
      return this.$storex.projects.allChats.filter(c => c.parent_id === this.chat.id)
        .sort((a, b) => (a.updated_at || a.created_at) > (b.updated_at || b.created_at) ? -1 : 1)
    },
    chatProject() {
      return this.$projects.allProjects.find(p => p.project_id === this.chat.project_id) ||
              this.$project
    },
    parentChat () {
      return this.$projects.allChats.find(c => c.id === this.chat.parent_id)
    },
    chatFiles() {
      return [...this.chat.file_list||[], ...this.parentChat?.file_list||[]]
    }
  },
  methods: {
    async saveChat() {
      this.editName = false
      await this.$projects.saveChat(this.chat)
    },
    async confirmDeleteChat() {
      this.confirmDelete = false
      const parent_id = this.chat.parent_id
      await this.$projects.deleteChat(this.chat)
      const parentChat = this.parentChat
      if (parentChat) {
        this.$projects.setActiveChat(parentChat)
      } else {
        this.navigateToChats()
      }
    },
    resetConfirmDelete() {
      this.confirmDelete = false
    },
    async loadChat(chat) {
      await this.$projects.setActiveChat(chat)
      this.showChatsTree = false
    },
    async removeFileFromContext() {
      this.chat.profiles = this.chat.profiles?.filter(f => f !== this.showFile)
      this.onRemoveFile(this.showFile)
      await this.loadChat(this.chat)
      this.showFile = null
    },
    async addFileToContext() {
      this.onAddFile(this.addFile)
      await this.saveChat()
      await this.loadChat(this.chat)
      this.showFile = null
      this.addFile = null
    },
    async onAddFile(file) {
      if (this.chat.file_list?.includes(file)) {
        return
      }
      this.chat.file_list = [...(this.chat.file_list || []), file]
      this.addNewFile = null
      await this.saveChat()
    },
    async onRemoveFile(file) {
      this.chat.file_list = (this.chat.file_list || []).filter(f => f !== file)
      this.addNewFile = null
      await this.saveChat()
    },
    async addProfile(profile) {
      if (this.chat.profiles?.includes(profile)) {
        return
      }
      this.chat.profiles = [...this.chat.profiles || [], profile]
      await this.saveChat()
    },
    removeProfile(profile) {
      if (this.chat.profiles?.includes(profile)) {
        this.chat.profiles = this.chat.profiles.filter(p => p !== profile)
        this.saveChat()
      }
    },
    onRemoveMessage(message) {
      const ix = this.chat.messages.findIndex(m => m.doc_id === message.doc_id)
      if (this.chat.mode == 'task' && message.role === "assistant" && ix > 1) {
        this.chat.messages[ix - 1].hide = false
      }
      this.chat.messages = this.chat.messages.filter((_, i) => i !== ix)
      this.saveChat()
    },
    navigateToChats() {
      this.$emit('chats')
    },
    async newSubChat() {
      this.showSubtaskModal = true
    },
    createSubtask() {
      if (this.subtaskName.trim()) {
        this.$emit('sub-task', {
          name: this.subtaskName,
          description: this.subtaskDescription
        })
        this.resetSubtaskModal()
      }
    },
    cancelSubtask() {
      this.resetSubtaskModal()
    },
    resetSubtaskModal() {
      this.showSubtaskModal = false
      this.subtaskName = ''
      this.subtaskDescription = ''
    },
    addNewTag() {
      this.chat.tags = [...new Set([...this.chat.tags || [], this.newTag])]
      this.newTag = null
      this.saveChat()
    },
    removeTag(tag) {
      this.chat.tags = this.chat.tags.filter(t => t !== tag)
      this.saveChat()
    },
    setChatMode(mode, profile) {
      this.chat.mode = mode
      this.chat.profiles = [profile]
      this.saveChat()
    },
    async createSubTasks() {
      await this.$storex.projects.createSubTasks(this.chat)
    },
    naviageToParent() {
      if (this.parentChat) {
        this.$emit('chat', this.parentChat)
      } else {
        this.navigateToChats()
      }
    }
  }
}
</script>

      this.chat.file_list = (this.chat.file_list || []).filter(f => f !== file)
      this.addNewFile = null
      await this.saveChat()
    },
    async addProfile(profile) {
      if (this.chat.profiles?.includes(profile)) {
        return
      }
      this.chat.profiles = [...this.chat.profiles || [], profile]
      await this.saveChat()
    },
    removeProfile(profile) {
      if (this.chat.profiles?.includes(profile)) {
        this.chat.profiles = this.chat.profiles.filter(p => p !== profile)
        this.saveChat()
      }
    },
    onRemoveMessage(message) {
      const ix = this.chat.messages.findIndex(m => m.doc_id === message.doc_id)
      if (this.chat.mode == 'task' && message.role === "assistant" && ix > 1) {
        this.chat.messages[ix - 1].hide = false
      }
      this.chat.messages = this.chat.messages.filter((_, i) => i !== ix)
      this.saveChat()
    },
    navigateToChats() {
      this.$emit('chats')
    },
    async newSubChat() {
      this.showSubtaskModal = true
    },
    createSubtask() {
      if (this.subtaskName.trim()) {
        this.$emit('sub-task', {
          name: this.subtaskName,
          description: this.subtaskDescription
        })
        this.resetSubtaskModal()
      }
    },
    cancelSubtask() {
      this.resetSubtaskModal()
    },
    resetSubtaskModal() {
      this.showSubtaskModal = false
      this.subtaskName = ''
      this.subtaskDescription = ''
    },
    addNewTag() {
      this.chat.tags = [...new Set([...this.chat.tags || [], this.newTag])]
      this.newTag = null
      this.saveChat()
    },
    removeTag(tag) {
      this.chat.tags = this.chat.tags.filter(t => t !== tag)
      this.saveChat()
    },
    setChatMode(mode, profile) {
      this.chat.mode = mode
      this.chat.profiles = [profile]
      this.saveChat()
    },
    async createSubTasks() {
      await this.$storex.projects.createSubTasks(this.chat)
    },
    naviageToParent() {
      if (this.parentChat) {
        this.$emit('chat', this.parentChat)
      } else {
        this.navigateToChats()
      }
    }
  }
}

            <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"></i>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- New Card -->

        <span class="text-gray-500">Add New Model</span>

<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      showDialog: false,
      showDeleteDialog: false,
      currentModel: this.initializeModel(),
      modelToDelete: null,
    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiModels() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings?.ai_models || []
    },
    currentModelIsLLM() {
      return this.currentModel?.model_type === 'llm'
    }
  },
  methods: {
    initializeModel() {
      return {
        name: '',
        ai_provider: '',
        model_type: 'llm',
        settings: {
          temperature: 1,
          vector_size: 1536,
          chunk_size: 8190,
        },
      }
    },
    editModel(model) {
      if (!model) {
        model = this.initializeModel()
        this.aiModels.push(model)
      }
      this.currentModel = { ...model }
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveModel() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save model
    },
    confirmDelete(model) {
      this.modelToDelete = model
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteModel() {
      const index = this.aiModels.findIndex(m => m.name === this.modelToDelete.name)
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiModels.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    },
  },
}
</script>
```

### Key Changes
1. **Grid Layout:** Replace the table with a grid using CSS classes, controlled by screen width for responsiveness.
2. **Card Structure:** Each card displays the AI Model information and includes action buttons aligned at the bottom.
3. **"New" Card:** A persistent "New" card is added with a dashed border which invokes the `editModel` method to add a new model.
4. **CSS Enhancements:** Ensure the use of utility classes to maintain consistency and responsiveness across different devices.

### Version Control
- Use `git init` to initialize a repository if not already done.
- Make a commit with `git add .` followed by `git commit -m "Refactor AIModels.vue to use card layout instead of table"`

### Test & Documentation
- **Unit Tests:** Consider writing Vue Test Utils tests for the component.
- **Documentation:** Document the change in the project’s documentation folder or update README to describe the UI changes and new functionality.

Following these steps will help keep the component clean, maintainable, and visually consistent with your project’s guidelines.

<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      showDialog: false,
      showDeleteDialog: false,
      currentModel: {
        name: '',
        ai_provider: '',
        model_type: 'llm',
        settings: {
          temperature: 1,
          vector_size: 1536,
          chunk_size: 8190,
        },
      },
      modelToDelete: null,
    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiModels() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings?.ai_models
    },
    currentModelIsLLM () {
      return this.currentModel?.model_type === 'llm'
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editModel(model) {
      if (!model) {
        model = { settings: {} }
        this.aiModels.push(model)
      }
      this.currentModel = model
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveModel() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save model
    },
    confirmDelete(model) {
      this.modelToDelete = model
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteModel() {
      const index = this.aiModels.findIndex(m => m.name === this.modelToDelete.name)
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiModels.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    },
  },
}
</script>

        model = this.initializeModel()
        this.aiModels.push(model)
      }
      this.currentModel = { ...model }
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveModel() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save model
    },
    confirmDelete(model) {
      this.modelToDelete = model
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteModel() {
      const index = this.aiModels.findIndex(m => m.name === this.modelToDelete.name)
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiModels.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    },
  },
}
</script>
```

### Key Changes
1. **Grid Layout:** Replace the table with a grid using CSS classes, controlled by screen width for responsiveness.
2. **Card Structure:** Each card displays the AI Model information and includes action buttons aligned at the bottom.
3. **"New" Card:** A persistent "New" card is added with a dashed border which invokes the `editModel` method to add a new model.
4. **CSS Enhancements:** Ensure the use of utility classes to maintain consistency and responsiveness across different devices.

### Version Control
- Use `git init` to initialize a repository if not already done.
- Make a commit with `git add .` followed by `git commit -m "Refactor AIModels.vue to use card layout instead of table"`

### Test & Documentation
- **Unit Tests:** Consider writing Vue Test Utils tests for the component.
- **Documentation:** Document the change in the project’s documentation folder or update README to describe the UI changes and new functionality.

Following these steps will help keep the component clean, maintainable, and visually consistent with your project’s guidelines.

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { useStore } from 'vuex'

// Set up any necessary imports or setup logic here
const store = useStore()

const showDialog = ref(false)
const showDeleteDialog = ref(false)
const currentModel = ref({
  name: '',
  ai_provider: '',
  model_type: 'llm',
  settings: {
    temperature: 1,
    vector_size: 1536,
    chunk_size: 8190
  }
})
const modelToDelete = ref(null)

const aiModels = computed(() => store.state.api.globalSettings?.ai_models)

function editModel(model) {
  if (!model) {
    model = { settings: {} }
    aiModels.value.push(model)
  }
  currentModel.value = model
  showDialog.value = true
}

function confirmDelete(model) {
  modelToDelete.value = model
  showDeleteDialog.value = true
}

function deleteModel() {
  const index = aiModels.value.findIndex(m => m.name === modelToDelete.value.name)
  if (index !== -1) {
    aiModels.value.splice(index, 1)
  }
  showDeleteDialog.value = false
}

// You can add more function definitions here as needed

</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { useStore } from 'vuex'

// Set up any necessary imports or setup logic here
const store = useStore()

const showDialog = ref(false)
const showDeleteDialog = ref(false)
const currentModel = ref({
  name: '',
  ai_provider: '',
  model_type: 'llm',
  settings: {
    temperature: 1,
    vector_size: 1536,
    chunk_size: 8190
  }
})
const modelToDelete = ref(null)

const aiModels = computed(() => store.state.api.globalSettings?.ai_models)

function editModel(model) {
  if (!model) {
    model = { settings: {} }
    aiModels.value.push(model)
  }
  currentModel.value = model
  showDialog.value = true
}

function confirmDelete(model) {
  modelToDelete.value = model
  showDeleteDialog.value = true
}

function deleteModel() {
  const index = aiModels.value.findIndex(m => m.name === modelToDelete.value.name)
  if (index !== -1) {
    aiModels.value.splice(index, 1)
  }
  showDeleteDialog.value = false
}

// You can add more function definitions here as needed

</script>

      this.showDeleteDialog = true

      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiModels.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}

              <script setup>
import { ref, onMounted, computed } from 'vue'
import { useStore } from 'vuex'

const store = useStore()

const showDialog = ref(false)
const showDeleteDialog = ref(false)
let modelToDelete = ref(null)
let currentModel = ref({
  name: '',
  ai_provider: '',
  model_type: 'llm',
  settings: {
    temperature: 1,
    vector_size: 1536,
    chunk_size: 8190,
  }
})

const aiModels = computed(() => store.state.api.globalSettings?.ai_models)

const editModel = (model) => {
  if (!model) {
    model = { settings: {} }
    aiModels.value.push(model)
  }
  currentModel.value = model
  showDialog.value = true
}

const confirmDelete = (model) => {
  modelToDelete.value = model
  showDeleteDialog.value = true
}

const deleteModel = () => {
  const index = aiModels.value.findIndex(m => m.name === modelToDelete.value.name)
  if (index !== -1) {
    aiModels.value.splice(index, 1)
  }
  showDeleteDialog.value = false
}

onMounted(() => {
  // Any initial setup can be done here
})
</script>

      <div
        v-for="model in aiModels"
        :key="model.name"
        class="card border border-base-300 p-4 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between"
        @click="editModel(model)"
      >
        <div>
          <h2 class="font-bold text-lg">{{ model.name }}</h2>
          <table class="table w-full">
            <tr>
              <td>Provider:</td>
              <td>{{ model.ai_provider }}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td :title="model.model_type">Type:</td>
              <td>
                <span class="badge badge-warning" v-if="model.model_type === 'llm'">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-brain"></i> LLM
                </span>
                <span class="badge badge-info" v-else>
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-file"></i> Embeddings
                </span>
              </td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td>Temperature:</td>
              <td>{{ model.settings.temperature || '-' }}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td>Vector Size:</td>
              <td>{{ model.settings.vector_size || '-' }}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>

          </div>

            <div :class="`badge badge-outline badge-${badgeColor[task.mode]}`">
              {{ task.mode }}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
        <span class="text-xs" :class="isToday ? 'font-bold' : 'text-gray-600'">{{ formattedDate }}</span>
        <div class="flex gap-1 justify-end">
          <div class="font-bold text-xs text-info flex gap-2" v-for="tag in task.tags" :key="tag">
            #{{ tag }}
          </div>
          <span class="text-xs tooltip"
            :data-tip="`${task.file_list?.length} files`"
            v-if="task.file_list?.length">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-paperclip"></i>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
        <div class="text-xs font-bold tooltip tooltip-left"
          :data-tip="`${subTasks.length} sub tasks`"
          v-if="subTasks.length">
          {{ subTasks.length }}
          <i class="fa-regular fa-file-lines"></i>
        </div>
        <div class="badge badge-xs badge-warning" v-if="chatProject">
          {{ chatProject.project_name }}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    @codx-ok, please-wait...: add a dropdown menu with options: settings, delete
  </div>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  components: {
    Badge,
    ChatIcon
  },
  props: ['task'],
  data () {
    return {
      badgeColor: {
        task: "primary",
        chat: "accent"
      }
    }
  },
  computed: {
    image() {
      let image = this.task.messages?.find(m => m.images.length)?.images[0]
      return image ? JSON.parse(image): null
    },
    isToday() {
      const updatedAt = this.task.updated_at;
      return moment(0, "HH").diff(updatedAt, "days") == 0
    },
    formattedDate() {
      const updatedAt = this.task.updated_at;
      return this.isToday
        ? moment(updatedAt).format('hh:mm:ss')
        : moment(updatedAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss');
    },
    subTasks() {
      return this.$storex.projects.allChats.filter(c => c.parent_id === this.task.id)
                .sort((a, b) => (a.updated_at || a.created_at) > (b.updated_at || b.created_at) ? -1 : 1)
    },
    chatProject() {
      return this.$projects.allProjects.find(p => p.project_id === this.task.project_id && 
                  p.project_id !== this.$project.project_id)
    },
    parentChat() {
      return this.$projects.chats[this.task.parent_id]
    }
  }
};
</script>

    :class="parentChat ? 'bg-base-100':'bg-base-300'"
  >
    <div class="bg-contain bg-no-repeat bg-center h-28 bg-base-300"
      :style="`background-image: url(${image.src})`"

          @click.stop="$projects.setActiveChat(parentChat)"
          v-if="parentChat">{{ parentChat.name }}</div>
        <div class="flex justify-between">
          <div class="font-semibold font-sans tracking-wide text-sm flex gap-2">
            <div class="rounded-full border-1">

            <div class="overflow-hidden">{{task.name}}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="flex gap-2 items-center">
            <div :class="`badge badge-outline badge-${badgeColor[task.mode]}`">
              {{ task.mode }}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
        <span class="text-xs" :class="isToday ? 'font-bold' : 'text-gray-600'">{{ formattedDate }}</span>
        <div class="flex gap-1 justify-end">
          <div class="font-bold text-xs text-info flex gap-2" v-for="tag in task.tags" :key="tag">
            #{{ tag }}
          </div>
          <span class="text-xs tooltip"
            :data-tip="`${task.file_list?.length} files`"
            v-if="task.file_list?.length">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-paperclip"></i>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
        <div class="text-xs font-bold tooltip tooltip-left"
          :data-tip="`${subTasks.length} sub tasks`"
          v-if="subTasks.length">
          {{ subTasks.length }}
          <i class="fa-regular fa-file-lines"></i>
        </div>
        <div class="badge badge-xs badge-warning" v-if="chatProject">
          {{ chatProject.project_name }}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    @codx-ok, please-wait...: add a dropdown menu with options: settings, delete
  </div>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  components: {
    Badge,
    ChatIcon
  },
  props: ['task'],
  data () {
    return {
      badgeColor: {
        task: "primary",
        chat: "accent"
      }
    }
  },
  computed: {
    image() {
      let image = this.task.messages?.find(m => m.images.length)?.images[0]
      return image ? JSON.parse(image): null
    },
    isToday() {
      const updatedAt = this.task.updated_at;
      return moment(0, "HH").diff(updatedAt, "days") == 0
    },
    formattedDate() {
      const updatedAt = this.task.updated_at;
      return this.isToday
        ? moment(updatedAt).format('hh:mm:ss')
        : moment(updatedAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss');
    },
    subTasks() {
      return this.$storex.projects.allChats.filter(c => c.parent_id === this.task.id)
                .sort((a, b) => (a.updated_at || a.created_at) > (b.updated_at || b.created_at) ? -1 : 1)
    },
    chatProject() {
      return this.$projects.allProjects.find(p => p.project_id === this.task.project_id && 
                  p.project_id !== this.$project.project_id)
    },
    parentChat() {
      return this.$projects.chats[this.task.parent_id]
    }
  }
};
</script>

    },

                  p.project_id !== this.$project.project_id)
    },

    }

      console.log('Delete clicked')
    }
  }
}

      :style="`background-image: url(${image.src})`"
      v-if="image">
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <div>
        <div class="text-xs text-primary/40 hover:text-primary text-nowrap text-ellipsis overflow-hidden"
          @click.stop="$projects.setActiveChat(parentChat)"
          v-if="parentChat">{{ parentChat.name }}</div>
        <div class="flex justify-between">
          <div class="font-semibold font-sans tracking-wide text-sm flex gap-2">
            <div class="rounded-full border">
              <ChatIcon :chat="task" />
            </div>
            <div class="overflow-hidden">{{task.name}}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="flex gap-2 items-center">
            <div :class="`badge badge-outline badge-${badgeColor[task.mode]}`">
              {{ task.mode }}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
        <span class="text-xs" :class="isToday ? 'font-bold' : 'text-gray-600'">{{ formattedDate }}</span>
        <div class="flex gap-1 justify-end">
          <span class="text-xs badge badge-info" v-for="tag in task.tags" :key="tag">
            #{{ tag }}
          </span>
          <span class="text-xs tooltip"
            :data-tip="`${task.file_list?.length} files`"
            v-if="task.file_list?.length">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-paperclip"></i>
          </span>
          <div class="dropdown dropdown-end">
            <label tabindex="0" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline">Options</label>
            <ul tabindex="0" class="dropdown-content menu p-2 shadow bg-base-100 rounded-box w-52">

            </ul>
          </div>

          :data-tip="`${subTasks.length} sub tasks`"
          v-if="subTasks.length">
          {{ subTasks.length }}
          <i class="fa-regular fa-file-lines"></i>
        </div>
        <div class="badge badge-xs badge-warning" v-if="chatProject">
          {{ chatProject.project_name }}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

export default {
  components: {
    Badge,
    ChatIcon
  },
  props: ['task'],
  data () {
    return {
      badgeColor: {
        task: "primary",
        chat: "accent"
      }
    }
  },
  computed: {
    image() {
      let image = this.task.messages?.find(m => m.images.length)?.images[0]
      return image ? JSON.parse(image): null
    },
    isToday() {
      const updatedAt = this.task.updated_at
      return moment(0, "HH").diff(updatedAt, "days") == 0
    },
    formattedDate() {
      const updatedAt = this.task.updated_at
      return this.isToday
        ? moment(updatedAt).format('hh:mm:ss')
        : moment(updatedAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss')
    },
    subTasks() {
      return this.$storex.projects.allChats.filter(c => c.parent_id === this.task.id)
                .sort((a, b) => (a.updated_at || a.created_at) > (b.updated_at || b.created_at) ? -1 : 1)
    },
    chatProject() {
      return this.$projects.allProjects.find(p => p.project_id === this.task.project_id && 
                  p.project_id !== this.$project.project_id)
    },
    parentChat() {
      return this.$projects.chats[this.task.parent_id]
    }
  },
  methods: {
    handleSettings() {
      console.log('Settings clicked')
    },
    handleDelete() {
      console.log('Delete clicked')
    }
  }
}
</script>

### 1. Add the Settings Icon

First, we'll add a settings icon to the component. This icon, when clicked, will open a modal dialog.

Modify the template section:

```html

### 2. Update the Script Section

We'll add methods for handling modal actions and declaring the necessary data properties:

```javascript
<script>
export default {
  components: {
    Badge,
    ChatIcon
  },
  props: ['task'],
  data () {
    return {
      isSettingsModalOpen: false,
      modalData: { // Captures the modal input for task name, board, and column
        name: this.task.name,
        board: '',  // Assuming these values are being managed somewhere
        column: ''
      },
      badgeColor: {
        task: "primary",
        chat: "accent"
      }
    }
  },
  methods: {
    openSettingsModal() {
      this.isSettingsModalOpen = true;
    },
    closeSettingsModal() {
      this.isSettingsModalOpen = false;
    },
    discardChanges() {
      this.closeSettingsModal();
    },
    saveChanges() {
      // Logic to save the changes to the task
      console.log('Task Saved:', this.modalData);
      this.closeSettingsModal();
    },
    deleteTask() {
      if (confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this task?")) {
        // Logic to delete the task
        console.log('Task Deleted');
        this.closeSettingsModal();
      }
    }
  },
  computed: {
    image() {
      let image = this.task.messages?.find(m => m.images.length)?.images[0]
      return image ? JSON.parse(image): null
    },
    isToday() {
      const updatedAt = this.task.updated_at;
      return moment(0, "HH").diff(updatedAt, "days") == 0
    },
    formattedDate() {
      const updatedAt = this.task.updated_at;
      return this.isToday
        ? moment(updatedAt).format('hh:mm:ss')
        : moment(updatedAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss');

    subTasks() {

                .sort((a, b) => (a.updated_at || a.created_at) > (b.updated_at || b.created_at) ? -1 : 1)
    },

                  p.project_id !== this.$project.project_id)
    },
    parentChat() {
      return this.$projects.chats[this.task.parent_id]
    }
  }
};
</script>

### 4. Version Control

- **Commit and Push Changes**: 
    1. Initialize the repository if it's not already using `git init`.
    2. Add changes using `git add .`.
    3. Commit with a meaningful message: `git commit -m "Added settings icon and modal for task management"`.
    4. Push to your repository: `git push origin main`.

### 5. Unit Tests

You should write tests to ensure the modal opens and actions perform correctly. Depending on your setup, this might involve setting up Jest or another testing framework.

### 6. Documentation

Update your project documentation to include details about the new task settings functionality and how to use it.

### 7. Agile Workflow

Ensure these tasks/issues are tracked on your project's Kanban board, assigned appropriate story points, and reviewed by another developer before merging the changes.

Implementing these steps ensures your code follows best practices and remains maintainable and scalable over time.

              To implement the requested changes, we'll need to add a settings icon that opens a modal for task settings within the `TaskCard.vue` component. We'll also implement the modal with the actions: discard, save, and delete, where the delete action requires confirmation. Here's how you can achieve this:

### 1. Add the Settings Icon

First, we'll add a settings icon to the component. This icon, when clicked, will open a modal dialog.

Modify the template section:

```html
<template>
  <div class="p-2 shadow rounded flex flex-col gap-2 click"
    :class="parentChat ? 'bg-base-100':'bg-base-300'"
  >
    <!-- ... existing code ... -->
    <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
      <!-- existing task details -->
      <div>
        <!-- Add settings icon here -->
        <i class="fa-solid fa-cog cursor-pointer" @click="openSettingsModal"></i>
      </div>
    </div>
    <!-- Modal -->
    <div v-if="isSettingsModalOpen" class="modal">
      <div class="modal-box">
        <h3 class="font-bold text-lg">Task Settings</h3>
        <div class="py-4">
          <!-- Task Name -->
          <label class="block">
            <span>Task Name</span>
            <input type="text" class="input input-bordered w-full" v-model="modalData.name">
          </label>
          <!-- Board -->
          <label class="block mt-4">
            <span>Board</span>
            <input type="text" class="input input-bordered w-full" v-model="modalData.board">
          </label>
          <!-- Column -->
          <label class="block mt-4">
            <span>Column</span>
            <input type="text" class="input input-bordered w-full" v-model="modalData.column">
          </label>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-action">
          <button class="btn" @click="discardChanges">Discard</button>
          <button class="btn btn-warning" @click="deleteTask">Delete</button>
          <button class="btn btn-primary" @click="saveChanges">Save</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

### 2. Update the Script Section

We'll add methods for handling modal actions and declaring the necessary data properties:

```javascript
<script>
export default {
  components: {
    Badge,
    ChatIcon
  },
  props: ['task'],
  data () {
    return {
      isSettingsModalOpen: false,
      modalData: { // Captures the modal input for task name, board, and column
        name: this.task.name,
        board: '',  // Assuming these values are being managed somewhere
        column: ''
      },
      badgeColor: {
        task: "primary",
        chat: "accent"
      }
    }
  },
  methods: {
    openSettingsModal() {
      this.isSettingsModalOpen = true;
    },
    closeSettingsModal() {
      this.isSettingsModalOpen = false;
    },
    discardChanges() {
      this.closeSettingsModal();
    },
    saveChanges() {
      // Logic to save the changes to the task
      console.log('Task Saved:', this.modalData);
      this.closeSettingsModal();
    },
    deleteTask() {
      if (confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this task?")) {
        // Logic to delete the task
        console.log('Task Deleted');
        this.closeSettingsModal();
      }
    }
  },
  computed: {
    image() {
      let image = this.task.messages?.find(m => m.images.length)?.images[0]
      return image ? JSON.parse(image): null
    },
    isToday() {
      const updatedAt = this.task.updated_at;
      return moment(0, "HH").diff(updatedAt, "days") == 0
    },
    formattedDate() {
      const updatedAt = this.task.updated_at;
      return this.isToday
        ? moment(updatedAt).format('hh:mm:ss')
        : moment(updatedAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss');
    },
    subTasks() {
      return this.$storex.projects.allChats.filter(c => c.parent_id === this.task.id)
                .sort((a, b) => (a.updated_at || a.created_at) > (b.updated_at || b.created_at) ? -1 : 1)
    },
    chatProject() {
      return this.$projects.allProjects.find(p => p.project_id === this.task.project_id && 
                  p.project_id !== this.$project.project_id)
    },
    parentChat() {
      return this.$projects.chats[this.task.parent_id]
    }
  }
};
</script>
```

### 3. Style the Modal

Ensure that you have appropriate styles for your modal, e.g., using Tailwind CSS or a component library like Bootstrap/Vuetify if you have them set up.

### 4. Version Control

- **Commit and Push Changes**: 
    1. Initialize the repository if it's not already using `git init`.
    2. Add changes using `git add .`.
    3. Commit with a meaningful message: `git commit -m "Added settings icon and modal for task management"`.
    4. Push to your repository: `git push origin main`.

### 5. Unit Tests

You should write tests to ensure the modal opens and actions perform correctly. Depending on your setup, this might involve setting up Jest or another testing framework.

### 6. Documentation

Update your project documentation to include details about the new task settings functionality and how to use it.

### 7. Agile Workflow

Ensure these tasks/issues are tracked on your project's Kanban board, assigned appropriate story points, and reviewed by another developer before merging the changes.

Implementing these steps ensures your code follows best practices and remains maintainable and scalable over time.

    project() {

    }

  watch: {
    project() {
      this.reloadSettings()
    }

  methods: {
    async reloadSettings() {
      this.settings = { ...this.$projects.activeProject }

    async saveSettings() {

    }

        </div>

          Delete project
        </div>

<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      settings: null,
      confirmDelete: false
    }
  },
  mounted() {
    this.reloadSettings()
  },
  computed: {
    project() {
      return this.$project
    }
  },
  watch: {
    project() {
      this.reloadSettings()
    }
  },
  methods: {
    async reloadSettings() {
      this.settings = { ...this.$projects.activeProject }
    },
    async saveSettings() {
      await this.$projects.saveSettings(this.settings)
      this.reloadSettings()
    },
    deleteProject() {
      if (this.confirmDelete) {
        this.$emit('delete')
      } else {
        this.confirmDelete = true
      }
    }
  }
}
</script>

# Vue vuejs coding best pratices
Vue files must always follow this structure in this order.
No other elements are valid:
```example vue file
<script setup>
import Component from './component.vue'
import markdown from 'mardown'
</script>
<template>
<div class="w.full h-full flex gap-2">
</div>
</template>
<script>
export default {
props: [].
data (){
 return { myVariable: null }
},
computed: {},
watch: {},
methods: {}
}
</sctipt>
```
* export default component object
* Use component "data" method to return an object variables
* Use component "computed" to define computed properties
" Use component "methods" to define component methods 
* "script setup" section contains ONLY imports, no variables, properties bnor methods
* Use TailwindCSS classes for styling, always consider mobile styles
* Vue component definition will be exporting a default object like, without ref, nor computed imports
* Don't use ";" in the javascript or typescript code
* Avoid long functions
* Add short and concise comments for complex functions
* Don't use <style> elements, use TailWindCSS classes

  settings.value = { ...API.$projects.activeProject }
}

  await API.$projects.saveSettings(settings.value)

}

}

    }
  },
  watch: {
    project() {
      this.reloadSettings()
    }
  },
  methods: {
    async reloadSettings() {
      this.settings = { ...this.$projects.activeProject }
    },
    async saveSettings() {
      await this.$projects.saveSettings(this.settings)
      this.reloadSettings()
    },
    deleteProject() {

      } else {
        this.confirmDelete = true

    }
  }

export default {
  data() {
    return {
      settings: null,
      confirmDelete: false
    }
  },
  mounted() {
    this.reloadSettings()
  },
  computed: {
    project() {
      return this.$project
    }
  },
  watch: {
    project() {
      this.reloadSettings()
    }
  },
  methods: {
    async reloadSettings() {
      this.settings = { ...this.$projects.activeProject }
    },
    async saveSettings() {
      await this.$projects.saveSettings(this.settings)
      this.reloadSettings()
    },
    deleteProject() {
      if (this.confirmDelete) {
        this.$emit('delete')
      } else {
        this.confirmDelete = true
      }
    }
  }
}
</script>

    aiProviders() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.currentProvider = provider
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save provider
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(
        p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name
      )
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}

    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiProviders() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.currentProvider = provider
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save provider
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(
        p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name
      )
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}

<template>
  <div class="w-full h-full flex flex-col gap-2 p-4">
    <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">AI Settings</h1>
    @codx-ok, please-wait...: --knowledge Copy the grid structure from AIModels to show the provider's info
    <div class="overflow-x-auto">
      <table class="table w-full">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Name</th>
            <th>Provider</th>
            <th>API URL</th>
            <th>API Key</th>
            <th>Actions</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr class="click" @click="editProvider(provider)" v-for="provider in aiProviders" :key="provider.name">
            <td>{{ provider.name }}</td>
            <td>{{ provider.provider }}</td>
            <td class="w-20 overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap text-ellipsis" :title="provider.api_url">{{ provider.api_url?.slice(0, 30) }}</td>
            <td class="w-20 overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap text-ellipsis" :title="provider.api_key">{{ provider.api_key?.slice(0, 30) }}</td>
            <td class="flex gap-2">
              <button class="btn btn-xs btn-circle btn-ghost" @click.stop="editProvider(provider)">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square"></i>
              </button>
              <button class="btn btn-xs btn-circle btn-ghost text-error" @click.stop="confirmDelete(provider)">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"></i>
              </button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    <div class="flex justify-end">
      <button class="btn btn-sm mt-2" @click="editProvider({})">
        Add New
      </button>
    </div>

    <modal v-if="showDialog">
      <div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">Provider Name</label>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered"
            v-model="currentProvider.name"
            placeholder="Provider Name"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">Provider Protocol</label>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered"
            v-model="currentProvider.provider"
            placeholder="Provider Protocol"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">API URL</label>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap text-ellipsis"
            v-model="currentProvider.api_url"
            placeholder="API URL"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">API Key</label>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap text-ellipsis"
            v-model="currentProvider.api_key"
            placeholder="API Key"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="modal-action">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" @click="saveProvider">
            Save
          </button>
          <button class="btn" @click="showDialog = false">
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </modal>

    <modal v-if="showDeleteDialog">
      <div>
        <p>Are you sure you want to delete {{ providerToDelete.name }}?</p>
        <div class="modal-action">
          <button class="btn btn-error" @click="deleteProvider">
            Confirm
          </button>
          <button class="btn" @click="showDeleteDialog = false">Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </modal>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      showDialog: false,
      showDeleteDialog: false,
      currentProvider: {},
      providerToDelete: null
    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiProviders() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.currentProvider = provider
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save provider
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(
        p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name
      )
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}
</script>

# Vue vuejs coding best pratices
Vue files must always follow this structure in this order.
No other elements are valid:
```example vue file
<script setup>
import Component from './component.vue'
import markdown from 'mardown'
</script>

<div class="w.full h-full flex gap-2">
</div>

<script>
export default {
props: [].
data (){
 return { myVariable: null }
},
computed: {},
watch: {},
methods: {}
}
</sctipt>
```
* export default component object
* Use component "data" method to return an object variables
* Use component "computed" to define computed properties
" Use component "methods" to define component methods 
* "script setup" section contains ONLY imports, no variables, properties bnor methods
* Use TailwindCSS classes for styling, always consider mobile styles
* Vue component definition will be exporting a default object like, without ref, nor computed imports
* Don't use ";" in the javascript or typescript code
* Avoid long functions
* Add short and concise comments for complex functions
* Don't use <style> elements, use TailWindCSS classes

import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { useStore } from 'vuex'

const store = useStore()

const showDialog = ref(false)
const showDeleteDialog = ref(false)
const currentProvider = ref({})
const providerToDelete = ref(null)

const aiProviders = computed(() => store.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers)

function editProvider(provider) {
  currentProvider.value = { ...provider }
  showDialog.value = true
}

function saveProvider() {
  showDialog.value = false
  // Add logic to save provider
}

function confirmDelete(provider) {
  providerToDelete.value = provider
  showDeleteDialog.value = true
}

function deleteProvider() {
  const index = aiProviders.value.findIndex(
    p => p.name === providerToDelete.value.name
  )
  if (index !== -1) {
    aiProviders.value.splice(index, 1)
  }
  showDeleteDialog.value = false
}
</script>

<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      showDialog: false,
      showDeleteDialog: false,
      currentProvider: {},
      providerToDelete: null
    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiProviders() {
      return this.$store.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.currentProvider = { ...provider }
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Logic to save provider
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(
        p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name
      )
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}
</script>

      showDialog: false,
      showDeleteDialog: false,
      currentProvider: {},
      providerToDelete: null
    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiProviders() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.currentProvider = provider
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save provider
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(
        p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name
      )
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}
</script>

import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { useStore } from 'vuex'

const store = useStore()
const showDialog = ref(false)
const showDeleteDialog = ref(false)
const currentProvider = ref({})
const providerToDelete = ref(null)

const aiProviders = computed(() => store.state.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers)

function editProvider(provider) {
  currentProvider.value = provider
  showDialog.value = true
}

function saveProvider() {
  showDialog.value = false
  // Add logic to save provider
}

function confirmDelete(provider) {
  providerToDelete.value = provider
  showDeleteDialog.value = true
}

function deleteProvider() {
  const index = aiProviders.value.findIndex(
    p => p.name === providerToDelete.value.name
  )
  if (index !== -1) {
    aiProviders.value.splice(index, 1)
  }
  showDeleteDialog.value = false
}
</script>

        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">Provider Name</label>
          <input class="input input-bordered" v-model="currentProvider.name" placeholder="Provider Name" />
        </div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">Provider Protocol</label>
          <input class="input input-bordered" v-model="currentProvider.provider" placeholder="Provider Protocol" />
        </div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">API URL</label>
          <input class="input input-bordered" v-model="currentProvider.api_url" placeholder="API URL" />
        </div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">API Key</label>
          <input class="input input-bordered" v-model="currentProvider.api_key" placeholder="API Key" />
        </div>
        <div class="modal-action">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" @click="saveProvider">
            Save
          </button>
          <button class="btn" @click="showDialog = false">
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </dialog>

    <dialog v-if="showDeleteDialog" class="modal">
      <form method="dialog" class="modal-box">
        <p>Are you sure you want to delete {{ providerToDelete.name }}?</p>
        <div class="modal-action">
          <button class="btn btn-error" @click="deleteProvider">

<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      showDialog: false,
      showDeleteDialog: false,
      currentProvider: {},
      providerToDelete: null,
    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiProviders() {
      return this.store.state.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.currentProvider = provider
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save provider
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(
        p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name
      )
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  },
  setup() {
    const store = useStore()
    return { store }
  }
}
</script>

    return {

      showDeleteDialog: false,
      currentProvider: {},
      providerToDelete: null
    }
  },

    aiProviders() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.currentProvider = provider
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save provider
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(
        p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name
      )
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}

<script>

  data() {
    return {
      showDialog: false,
      showDeleteDialog: false,
      currentProvider: {},
      providerToDelete: null
    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiProviders() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.currentProvider = provider
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save provider
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(
        p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name
      )
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}
</script>

# Vue vuejs coding best pratices
Vue files must always follow this structure in this order.
No other elements are valid:
```example vue file
<script setup>
import Component from './component.vue'
import markdown from 'mardown'
</script>
<template>
<div class="w.full h-full flex gap-2">
</div>
</template>
<script>
export default {
props: [].
data (){
 return { myVariable: null }
},
computed: {},
watch: {},
methods: {}
}
</sctipt>
```
* export default component object
* Use component "data" method to return an object variables
* Use component "computed" to define computed properties
" Use component "methods" to define component methods 
* "script setup" section contains ONLY imports, no variables, properties bnor methods
* Use TailwindCSS classes for styling, always consider mobile styles
* Vue component definition will be exporting a default object like, without ref, nor computed imports
* Don't use ";" in the javascript or typescript code
* Avoid long functions
* Add short and concise comments for complex functions
* Don't use <style> elements, use TailWindCSS classes

import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { useStore } from 'vuex'

const showDialog = ref(false)
const showDeleteDialog = ref(false)
const currentProvider = ref({})
const providerToDelete = ref(null)

const aiProviders = computed(() => store.state.globalSettings?.ai_providers)

function editProvider(provider) {
  currentProvider.value = provider
  showDialog.value = true
}

function saveProvider() {
  showDialog.value = false
  // Add logic to save provider
}

function confirmDelete(provider) {
  providerToDelete.value = provider
  showDeleteDialog.value = true
}

function deleteProvider() {
  const index = aiProviders.value.findIndex(p => p.name === providerToDelete.value.name)
  if (index !== -1) {
    aiProviders.value.splice(index, 1)
  }
  showDeleteDialog.value = false
}
</script>

          <h2 class="card-title">{{ provider.name }}</h2>
          <p><strong>Provider:</strong> {{ provider.provider }}</p>

<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      showDialog: false,
      showDeleteDialog: false,
      providerForm: {},
      providerToDelete: null
    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiProviders() {
      const store = useStore()
      return store.state.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.providerForm = { ...provider }
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Implement save logic
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name)
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}
</script>

            <td class="w-20 overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap text-ellipsis" :title="provider.api_key">{{ provider.api_key?.slice(0, 30) }}</td>

          <input
            class="input input-bordered"
            v-model="currentProvider.provider"
            placeholder="Provider Protocol"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">API URL</label>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap text-ellipsis"
            v-model="currentProvider.api_url"
            placeholder="API URL"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">API Key</label>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap text-ellipsis"
            v-model="currentProvider.api_key"
            placeholder="API Key"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="modal-action">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" @click="saveProvider">
            Save
          </button>

      </div>

<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      showDialog: false,
      showDeleteDialog: false,
      currentProvider: {},
      providerToDelete: null
    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiProviders() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.currentProvider = provider
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save provider
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(
        p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name
      )
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}
</script>

<template>

    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
      <div
        class="card bordered"
        @click="editProvider(provider)"
        v-for="provider in aiProviders"
        :key="provider.name"
      >
        <div class="card-body">

          <p><strong>Provider:</strong> {{ provider.provider }}</p>
          <p><strong>API URL:</strong> {{ provider.api_url?.slice(0, 30) }}</p>
          <p><strong>API Key:</strong> {{ provider.api_key?.slice(0, 30) }}</p>
          <div class="card-actions justify-end">
            <button class="btn btn-xs" @click.stop="editProvider(provider)">
              Edit
            </button>
            <button class="btn btn-xs btn-error" @click.stop="confirmDelete(provider)">
              Delete
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        Add New
      </button>
    </div>

      <div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">Provider Name</label>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered"
            v-model="currentProvider.name"
            placeholder="Provider Name"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">Provider Protocol</label>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered"
            v-model="currentProvider.provider"
            placeholder="Provider Protocol"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">API URL</label>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered"
            v-model="currentProvider.api_url"
            placeholder="API URL"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="form-control">
          <label class="label">API Key</label>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered"
            v-model="currentProvider.api_key"
            placeholder="API Key"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="modal-action">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" @click="saveProvider">
            Save
          </button>
          <button class="btn" @click="showDialog = false">
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </modal>

    <modal v-if="showDeleteDialog">
      <div>
        <p>Are you sure you want to delete {{ providerToDelete.name }}?</p>
        <div class="modal-action">
          <button class="btn btn-error" @click="deleteProvider">
            Confirm
          </button>
          <button class="btn" @click="showDeleteDialog = false">Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </modal>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      showDialog: false,
      showDeleteDialog: false,
      currentProvider: {},
      providerToDelete: null
    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiProviders() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.currentProvider = provider
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save provider
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(
        p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name
      )
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}
</script>

        <div class="form-control mb-2">
          <label class="label">API Key</label>
          <input
            class="input input-bordered"
            v-model="currentProvider.api_key"
            placeholder="API Key"
          />
        </div>
        <div class="modal-action">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" @click="saveProvider">
            Save
          </button>
          <button class="btn" @click="closeDialog">
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </modal>

    <modal v-if="showDeleteDialog" @close="closeDeleteDialog">
      <div class="p-4">
        <p>Are you sure you want to delete {{ providerToDelete.name }}?</p>
        <div class="modal-action">
          <button class="btn btn-error" @click="deleteProvider">
            Confirm
          </button>
          <button class="btn" @click="closeDeleteDialog">Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </modal>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      showDialog: false,
      showDeleteDialog: false,
      currentProvider: {},
      providerToDelete: null
    }
  },
  computed: {
    aiProviders() {
      return this.$storex.api.globalSettings?.ai_providers
    }
  },
  methods: {
    editProvider(provider) {
      this.currentProvider = provider
      this.showDialog = true
    },
    saveProvider() {
      this.showDialog = false
      // Add logic to save provider here
    },
    confirmDelete(provider) {
      this.providerToDelete = provider
      this.showDeleteDialog = true
    },
    deleteProvider() {
      const index = this.aiProviders.findIndex(
        p => p.name === this.providerToDelete.name
      )
      if (index !== -1) {
        this.aiProviders.splice(index, 1)
      }
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    },
    closeDialog() {
      this.showDialog = false
    },
    closeDeleteDialog() {
      this.showDeleteDialog = false
    }
  }
}
</script>

          <tr class="click" @click="editProvider(provider)" v-for="provider in aiProviders" :key="provider.name">
            <td>{{ provider.name }}</td>
            <td>{{ provider.provider }}</td>
            <td class="w-20 overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap text-ellipsis" :title="provider.api_url">{{ provider.api_url?.slice(0, 30) }}</td>
            <td class="w-20 overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap text-ellipsis" :title="provider.api_key">{{ provider.api_key?.slice(0, 30) }}</td>
            <td class="flex gap-2">
              <button class="btn btn-xs btn-circle btn-ghost" @click.stop="editProvider(provider)">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square"></i>
              </button>
              <button class="btn btn-xs btn-circle btn-ghost text-error" @click.stop="confirmDelete(provider)">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"></i>
              </button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>

      </button>
